rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, group, or force showing ill will or an enemy-like attitude.

example.english: Those people are very hostile toward new immigrants.
example.traditional: 嗰班人對新移民好有敵意。
example.jyutping: go2 baan1 jan4 deoi3 san1 ji4 man4 hou2 jau5 dik6 ji3

rows.note: Use this when hostile specifically means aggressive or likely to attack.

example.english: This dog gets very hostile when it sees strangers.
example.traditional: 呢隻狗見到陌生人就好有攻擊性。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau2 gin3 dou2 mak6 sang1 jan4 zau6 hou2 jau5 gung1 gik1 sing3

rows.note: Use this when someone is hostile in the narrower sense of being unwilling or uncooperative.

example.english: They were hostile to the overtime arrangement and refused to cooperate.
example.traditional: 佢對加班安排好唔情願，點講都唔肯合作。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 gaa1 baan1 on1 paai4 hou2 m4 cing4 jyun6 dim2 gong2 dou1 m4 hang2 hap6 zok3
